text:
tess: Filing a docs PR — customer hit an SELinux relabel issue when the HSM plugin binds a socket under /tmp on RHEL9 with PrivateTmp. PR has a small migration script + suggested systemd fragment for persistent socket dir: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4751

amir: can you paste the AVC so we capture exact labels?

tess: here's the audit line I pulled from journalctl:
`Jun 02 07:11:02 host audit[4210]: AVC avc:  denied  { open } for pid=4210 comm=\"redwood-hsm-plugin\" name=pkcs11.sock scontext=system_u:system_r:redwood_t:s0 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:tmp_t:s0 tclass=unix_stream_socket`

claire: TL;DR PrivateTmp causes a tmp_t label and redwood_t can't open tmp_t. We should recommend a persistent dir like /var/run/redwood/hsm (or /var/lib/redwood/hsm-socket) and ensure SELinux fcontext at install time.

amir: add both semanage and chcon examples. also mention that systems with SELinux full relabel (e.g., after package install) may lose chcon changes; prefer semanage for persistence.

tess: PR includes this systemd override suggestion (keeps PrivateTmp but uses RuntimeDirectory so socket lives under /run):
```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-hsm.service.d/20-runtime-socket.conf
[Service]
PrivateTmp=yes
RuntimeDirectory=redwood-hsm
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755
ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /run/redwood/hsm
ExecStartPre=/bin/chown redwood:redwood /run/redwood/hsm || true
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/semanage fcontext -a -t var_run_t '/run/redwood/hsm(/.*)?' || true
ExecStartPre=/sbin/restorecon -R /run/redwood/hsm || true
# plugin will bind to /run/redwood/hsm/pkcs11.sock
```

claire: include a short AppArmor note for Ubuntu: add `/run/redwood/hsm/*` to the hsm profile and reload with `apparmor_parser -r`.

amir: security asked we explicitly avoid telling people to run `setenforce 0` or disable SELinux. add a "do not disable" sentence in Troubleshooting FAQ.

tess: migration script in PR (minimal, works offline):
```
#!/bin/sh
if [ -S /tmp/pkcs11.sock ]; then
  systemctl stop redwood-hsm || true
  mkdir -p /run/redwood/hsm
  mv /tmp/pkcs11.sock /run/redwood/hsm/
  chown root:root /run/redwood/hsm/pkcs11.sock
  if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    /sbin/restorecon -R /run/redwood/hsm || true
  fi
  systemctl start redwood-hsm || true
  echo migrated
else
  echo nothing to do
fi
```

docs-bot: small suggestion: move semanage examples to Advanced SELinux section and keep chcon in Quickstart for minimal air-gapped images.

amir: +1. claire, can you do a short copyedit and then we can ask security to quick-approve wording?
